reviews.review: A very fun and interesting idea for a game ruined by it being 90% RNG. I love card games and horror so this was a must for me to try and to its credit ITS FUN! At least for a couple rounds...Then becomes very annoying very quick. Your main objective is to find these Altar cards by investigating the locations around the area your in and by doing so you will destroy them. Destroy enough altars and you win, all the while finding weapons, buffs for said weapons/items, first aid kits things of that nature. There is a total card count of the deck on the board and one card every round will be sent to each location, once the deck runs out of cards you lose. So you need to be able to win before all cards land on the board. A big problem you very soon realize is since cards are random as to where they are/go you will need to send someone to investigate an area either with a flashlight (To reveal only one card at a time unless the flashlight is upgraded) or just go there in person. If a cultist happens to be there your dead unless you have a hatchet. UNLESS Unless theres multiple then your dead. UNLESS UNLESS Unless you have a upgraded hatchet so you can kill them all. So unless things go your way early on you can end up in situations where it is impossible to find the altar cards because they have enemies on them and you can't get a weapon. The boss on each run is also for the most part undodgeable and will always kill/damage you if you happen to investigate the area they are currently in (This changes based on said boss). This game just needs some simple tweaks and it can turn into a very fun game. Also they have perks and skins in the game that can only be unlocked with tokens that you earn after WINNING a match. Since you winning is basically RNG it may take several attempts/games to even get a win let alone a couple so you can start to buy perks to help yourself out against the oppressive rng. I really do want to like this game but as it stands I would tell you to look elsewhere.
